THE VEHICLE / 2026

Built for the next dimension.

Based on Tesla’s Roadster page as viewed on October 16, 2026. The model approximates the new 2026 front, side and rear views: a white wedge body, copper glass, hidden triangular headlights and a full-width rear light. Paint colors are selectable.

Aerospace white
TrimAnnounced features
PerformanceTwo seats, active aerodynamics, multimode ground grip
ThrustTwo seats, rear cold-gas thrust, announced 0–60 mph under 1 second
RocketSingle seat, perimeter thrusters, lift and rotation; not for public roads

This game uses simplified physics. The 1.6-second electric acceleration target is an in-game setting, not a real-car measurement. Speed limits, gas recharge, grip and flight forces are gameplay values. Jets provide vertical thrust and three-axis rotation, with no forward boost or automatic hover. Vehicle sounds are synthesized with Web Audio, not Tesla recordings. NEON VECTOR is an original 132 BPM cyberpunk soundtrack with separate music and volume controls. The ramp is a 180° half arc with a short inverted platform, not a 360° loop. Dimensions, forces and the visual mesh are game approximations based on official images, not factory CAD or a surveyed demonstration course.
